title: GTA 6's Jason Duval: Army vet, smuggler, and now he wants out 🔫 #Shorts
description:
Who is Jason Duval? Everything Rockstar says about GTA 6's male lead: grew up around grifters, served in the Army, went back to work for drug runners in the Florida Keys, and is thinking about a career change.

Source: Rockstar Games official GTA VI character page (rockstargames.com/VI). Footage: official Rockstar trailers.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
